module.name: DOMAINTAINS
module.description: DOMAINTAINS activation and status module for FreePBX 16 and 17.
module.changelog: *0.3.3-dev* Retrying activation on an installation with retained state now performs a full provider refresh: after local signing-identity and activation-key checks, a freshly signed claim (new timestamp and nonce, same signing identity) is sent and the validated provider response becomes authoritative. Refreshed numbers and trunks are persisted as pending before FreePBX changes, then reconciled and verified end to end, providing self-repair for changed numbers and SIP endpoints. Remote failures leave the last known-good state untouched and make no local changes; local failures keep the refreshed state pending with a safe diagnostic for retry. *0.3.2-dev* Adds conservative role-based migration of legacy DOMAINTAINS-managed trunks and in-place provider-host reconciliation through FreePBX Core APIs. Preserves existing trunk IDs, valid managed names, and outbound route references; normalizes SIP authentication settings and rejects ambiguous upgrade mappings. New trunks retain host-derived hash names for compatibility pending stable provider-issued trunk identities. Full local verification and safe retry diagnostics remain enforced. *0.3.1-dev* Distinguishes remote activation failures from local reconciliation failures and preserves safe allowlisted local errors. Persists last_error and last_error_stage, exposes diagnostic status in the GUI and CLI, and clears persisted errors after a successful retry. *0.3.0* Adds provider-authorised telephone numbers and automatic exact-DID inbound routes to the DOMAINTAINS Test answering destination for audible inbound-call confirmation. Conflicting administrator inbound routes fail closed. PJSIP Authentication=None uses authentication=off, Registration=None remains registration=none, and SIP authentication credentials are explicitly blank. Existing DOMAINTAINS-managed trunks are normalized in place. Outbound routing remains restricted to outbound-role trunks, and provisioned=true is persisted only after complete local verification. *0.2.0* Adds secure service activation through the DOMAINTAINS GUI and fwconsole command, with persistent local activation status.
